title: fix(run): forward a skill stderr on exit 0, not only on failure
description:
## .what

when a skill writes to stderr and exits 0, rhx drops those stderr bytes: neither stream carries them to the caller. on a nonzero exit the child output does surface, so the loss is scoped to the exit-0 path.

checkable evidence, ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhrain, 2026-09-23. the skill census.review-prefix writes a refusal to stderr and exits 0 when it finds no log root:

    🦉 no review logs at <path>
       fix: run a review here first, or point --at at a tree where reviews ran

spawned directly via its .sh, both lines reach stderr (an acceptance case asserts it, green). through the runner:

    $ rhx census.review-prefix --at /tmp/does-not-exist-xyz
    🪨 run solid skill repo=.this/role=any/skill=census.review-prefix

    EXIT=0

both lines are gone.

## .why

several skills deliberately exit 0 on a soft refusal so they do not gate a pipeline. each one carefully worded fix line reaches no reader, and the silence reads as a clean result. it is invisible to any suite that spawns the skill rather than the runner.

## .shape of the fix

- in the skill exec path, inherit or forward the child stderr on every exit code, not only nonzero. the child already owns fd 2; the runner should not filter it
- clamp: a fixture skill that writes one line to stderr and exits 0; spawn it through rhachet run --skill and assert the line reaches the caller stderr
